To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

our proposed approximation-aware cache architecture improves the energy efficiency of MLC STT- RAM caches by 7%--19% while incurring minimal output quality degradation (-0.219%-0.426% on average) for applications that are resilient to errors.

the proposed MLC STT- RAM based cache architecture with approximation-aware read and store policies can improve the energy-efficiency by up to 19%, while incurring minimal output quality degradation of up to 0.42%.

the proposed MLC STT-DRAM based architecture with approximation-aware management can improve the energy consumption of the cache by 7% to 19%, on average, for the next-generation advanced multimedia encoding applications, while incurring only 0.219%--0.426% quality penalty in the application output, and the hardware cost of the architecture is negligible.

the design of energy-efficient approximation-aware caches for emerging MLC STT- RAM memory technology.
the design of an approximation-aware MTC STT-RAM architecture for last-level caches in the context of manycore processors.
the design of energy-efficient MLC STT RAM caches, which can tolerate errors in a reliable manner and support quality control for applications with different resilience characteristics.

our architecture is a promising solution for the emerging manycore processors that are equipped with MLC STT- RAM caches.
our approximation-aware cache architecture is a promising approach to achieve high energy-efficiency in large-sized caches while meeting the reliability constraints.
our proposed architecture provides significant energy efficiency improvements while maintaining the required quality of results and reliability for the next-generation memory-intensive applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose an energy-efficient MLC STT- RAM cache architecture, which can support variable resilience characteristics of applications and provide runtime control on the error-tolerance level.
our approximation-aware cache architecture can improve energy efficiency by 5%--19% while incurring negligible quality penalties in the application results.

our proposed MLC STT RAM-based cache architecture is capable of providing a high energy efficiency with a low hardware overhead, which makes it a promising solution for the future manycore processors with large on-chip caches.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the approximation-aware management in the MLC STT- RAM based cache architecture can be leveraged to achieve high energy-efficiency and reliability, while supporting the resilience requirements of the applications with minimal hardware overheads.
the emerging MLC STT- RAM can be used in the last-level cache for energy-efficient processing of memory-intensive applications.

MLC STT- RAM can be effectively leveraged to improve the energy efficiency of the large-sized cache banks, while ensuring high quality of applications results under a user-specified error tolerance level.
